# Dr. Justinas Mišeikis

> AI and robotics advisor and speaker based in Zurich, Switzerland, working internationally in English. Helps technology companies enter markets and build Swiss partnerships, helps investors scout and assess Swiss AI and robotics startups from early stage to scale-up, and advises teams on internal AI workflows. Host of TechDrive Zürich.

Website: https://jmiseikis.com
Contact: the protected contact form at https://jmiseikis.com/#contact or LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/in/justinasmiseikis/). Engagements are cash-paid and scoped per project; fees on request.

## Pages

- [Home](https://jmiseikis.com/): Overview of advisory, relevant experience, speaking, resources, research and contact.
- [Advisory](https://jmiseikis.com/advisory): Market entry and Swiss partnerships; startup scouting and technical diligence; Swiss presence and strategic support; AI for internal data and workflows. Engagement formats: focused project, recurring strategic support, event representation.
- [Due diligence](https://jmiseikis.com/due-diligence): Technical and commercial assessment of AI, robotics and deep tech opportunities for investors, acquirers and strategy teams, with early-stage and scale-up evidence lists and a downloadable checklist.
- [Speaking](https://jmiseikis.com/speaking): Keynotes, panels and workshops on physical AI, corporate-startup collaboration and evaluating AI and robotics beyond the pitch. Includes a recorded talk from CAIRO Forum, Zürich, talks, shorts and TechDrive Zürich episodes. Bookings also via Premium Speakers.
- [About](https://jmiseikis.com/about): Professional history and education.
- [Publications & patents](https://jmiseikis.com/publications): Selected papers with links to the full Google Scholar and Google Patents records.
- [Resources](https://jmiseikis.com/resources): Decision guides, directories, tools and blank worksheets.
- [Swiss AI & robotics ecosystem guide](https://jmiseikis.com/swiss-ai-robotics-ecosystem): Selective, source-linked starting points for research, university startups, applied R&D and innovation support, plus investor questions by stage.
- [Swiss & Baltic market-entry guide](https://jmiseikis.com/swiss-baltic-market-entry): Market entry into Switzerland and international growth for Swiss startups, with public Lithuanian, Latvian and Estonian ecosystem starting points and a 90-day planning sequence.
- [AI for internal data & workflows](https://jmiseikis.com/ai-agents-strategy): Four illustrative internal workflows (knowledge, support, proposals, procurement), process and data mapping, pilot criteria and a blank pilot brief. Examples are illustrative, not client case studies.
- [Robotics in the Greater Zurich Area](https://jmiseikis.com/gza-robotics): Directory of robotics companies, research labs and autonomous systems organisations; data curated by Greater Zurich Area; includes a map PDF.
- [Swiss VCs & funds](https://jmiseikis.com/swiss-vcs): Directory of Swiss investors by sector, stage, geography and audience, with links to original sources. Fund-size figures are reproduced from the source's "Estimated Fund Size" field and are not current assets under management.
- [Swiss technology events](https://jmiseikis.com/tech-events): Calendar and archive of Swiss technology events with category, size, canton, scope and date filters.
- [RaaS ROI calculator](https://jmiseikis.com/raas-calculator): Robots-as-a-service scenario model that keeps cash savings separate from productivity value. Results are illustrative, not forecasts or benchmarks.
- [Deutsch](https://jmiseikis.com/de): German introduction. Work and talks are delivered in English.

## Experience

- Sony AI (2024 - present): research commercialisation strategy, project direction, budgets and external partnerships across four R&D teams.
- Sony (2021 - 2024): Principal Technology Analyst; technology scouting and analysis.
- F&P Robotics AG (2020 - 2021): Head of Artificial Intelligence; human-robot interaction, perception and manipulation.

## Education

- PhD in Robotics and Computer Vision, University of Oslo
- Executive MBA, Quantic School of Business and Technology
